blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers brewed on site, including core and rotating taps, as well as a full food menu featuring salads, sandwiches, soups, and desserts. The brewery emphasizes community and sustainability, with a focus on local ingredients and no distribution outside Cumberland. They also offer local pickup and shipping for merchandise and gift cards.
extraNote: No outside food allowed · Shipping: $15 flat rate within BC, $20 within Canada; no international shipping
